#!/usr/bin/python
import os, csv
base = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))

f.write('invoice_id,outstanding_cents\n')
for row in list(csv.reader(open(os.path.join(base, 'invoices.csv'))))[1:]:
    f.write(','.join(row) + '\n')
f.close()
